about: Files that must never reach the photo picker's pool (scripts/pick-pool.mjs). Source: docs/media-picks.md and the held items in CLAUDE.md. A candidate is denied when any token in `match` equals, ignoring case, the candidate's file name without extension, its _web id, or the stem of the original it was converted from. Matching ignores the slug, so a file filed under the wrong project is still caught. `edits` are privacy cuts the pool applies to a clip before anyone sees it; pin-picks.mjs copies them into the manifest entry.
